item.title: Longview resurrects spay-neuter-release program to limit stray cats
item.description: To save money on sheltering animals and ensure the local animal shelter is less crowded, the Longview City Council OK’d Thursday a new program to bring stray cats to the humane society to be spayed or neutered, then returned to the streets.

item.title: Trump says Board of Peace will unveil $5B in Gaza reconstruction pledges at inaugural meeting
item.description: WEST PALM BEACH, Fla. — President Donald Trump said Sunday that members of his newly created Board of Peace have pledged $5 billion toward rebuilding war-ravaged Gaza and will commit thousands of personnel to international stabilization and police forces for the territory.

item.title: Israel will begin contentious West Bank land registration in new step to deepen control
item.description: TEL AVIV, Israel — Israel will begin a contentious land regulation process in a large part of the occupied West Bank, which could result in Israel gaining control over wide swaths of the area for future development, according to a government decision on Sunday.

item.title: Ukrainian drone strike ignites fires at Russian Black Sea port
item.description: A Ukrainian drone strike ignited fires at one of Russia’s Black Sea ports, officials said Sunday, ahead of fresh talks aimed at ending the nearly 4-year-old war.

item.title: Protests, violence, little snow: Idaho lawmakers call for prayer and fasting
item.description: BOISE, Idaho — American politics have gotten ugly. Debates and disagreements have gotten personal. Angst over immigration, the economy and state budget cuts “sow seeds of unrest in Idaho and throughout the land,” according to a resolution proposed by GOP House Majority Leader Jason Monks.

item.title: Iran’s top diplomat to attend ‘indirect’ talks with U.S. in Geneva
item.description: DUBAI, United Arab Emirates — Iran’s top diplomat was traveling Sunday from Tehran to Geneva, where the second round of nuclear negotiations with the U.S. will take place, Iranian state media reported.

item.title: A storm system sweeps across the Southeast triggering tornado watches and damaging winds
item.description: ATLANTA — A weekend storm system sweeping across the Southeast brought tornado warnings to Mississippi and Louisiana, and then took aim at parts of Georgia and Florida, as people in the Northeast were finally getting a reprieve from weeks of bitterly cold temperatures.

item.title: Trump’s border czar says ‘small’ security force will remain in Minnesota after enforcement drawdown
item.description: WASHINGTON — White House border czar Tom Homan said Sunday that more than 1,000 immigration agents have left Minnesota's Twin Cities area and hundreds more will depart in the days ahead as part of the Trump administration’s drawdown of its immigration enforcement surge.

item.title: Tyler Reddick wins the Daytona 500 for Michael Jordan-owned 23XI Racing
item.description: DAYTONA BEACH, Fla. (AP) — Tyler Reddick won the Daytona 500 in a car owned by Michael Jordan when Chase Elliott crashed as he and Reddick were battling for the win in NASCAR's season opener.

item.title: Seahawks to hire 49ers’ Brian Fleury as offensive coordinator
item.description: SEATTLE — While Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald indicated he would strongly favor continuity in replacing Klint Kubiak as offensive coordinator, he ultimately decided to go outside the organization, reportedly hiring San Francisco 49ers run game coordinator and tight ends coach Brian Fleury as Seattle’s new OC.
